<PropertyGroup>
    <PreBuildEvent>if $(ConfigurationName) == Release "BuildDateWriter.exe" "$(ProjectDir)\Resources\BuildDate.txt"</PreBuildEvent>

    <PostBuildEvent>if $(ConfigurationName) == Release xcopy "$(SolutionDir)Languages\*.ini" "$(SolutionDir)Release\lang\*.ini" /y

  </PropertyGroup>

edits.new:
<!-- Keep generated metadata in obj; clean builds need no untracked helper executables. -->
  <Target Name="GenerateBuildDate" BeforeTargets="CoreCompile">
    <PropertyGroup>
      <_BuildDateValue>$([System.DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('u').Substring(0, 10))</_BuildDateValue>
    </PropertyGroup>
    <WriteLinesToFile File="$(IntermediateOutputPath)BuildDate.g.cs" Overwrite="true" WriteOnlyWhenDifferent="true" Encoding="UTF-8" Lines="namespace youtube_dl_gui { internal static class GeneratedBuildDate { internal const string Value = "$(_BuildDateValue)"%3B } }" />
  </Target>
  <Target Name="PackageRelease" AfterTargets="Build" Condition="'$(Configuration)' == 'Release'">
    <PropertyGroup>
      <_ReleaseRoot>$(MSBuildProjectDirectory)\..\Release</_ReleaseRoot>
      <_ReleaseStage>$(IntermediateOutputPath)Package</_ReleaseStage>
    </PropertyGroup>
    <!-- Never zip the destination directory into itself or sweep unrelated files into a release. -->
    <RemoveDir Directories="$(_ReleaseStage)" />
    <MakeDir Directories="$(_ReleaseStage)\lang;$(_ReleaseRoot)\lang" />
    <ItemGroup>
      <_ReleaseLanguages Include="$(MSBuildProjectDirectory)\..\Languages\*.ini" />
    </ItemGroup>
    <Copy SourceFiles="$(TargetPath)" DestinationFolder="$(_ReleaseStage)" />
    <Copy SourceFiles="@(_ReleaseLanguages)" DestinationFolder="$(_ReleaseStage)\lang" />
    <ZipDirectory SourceDirectory="$(_ReleaseStage)" DestinationFile="$(_ReleaseRoot)\$(TargetName).zip" Overwrite="true" />
    <Copy SourceFiles="$(TargetPath)" DestinationFolder="$(_ReleaseRoot)" />
    <Copy SourceFiles="@(_ReleaseLanguages)" DestinationFolder="$(_ReleaseRoot)\lang" />
    <GetFileHash Files="$(_ReleaseRoot)\$(TargetFileName)" Algorithm="SHA256">
      <Output TaskParameter="Hash" PropertyName="_ReleaseExeHash" />
    </GetFileHash>
    <GetFileHash Files="$(_ReleaseRoot)\$(TargetName).zip" Algorithm="SHA256">
      <Output TaskParameter="Hash" PropertyName="_ReleaseZipHash" />
    </GetFileHash>
    <WriteLinesToFile File="$(_ReleaseRoot)\Release-hashes.md" Overwrite="true" Encoding="UTF-8" Lines="exe sha256: $(_ReleaseExeHash);zip sha256: $(_ReleaseZipHash)" />
  </Target>
</Project>
